meta.author: Bart Bossuyt
meta.description: English translations for the Biesse2Csv GUI

changes.description: Initial English translations for the main window, menus, settings and messages.
Added translations for overwrite confirmation when CSV/XLSX output already exists and for skipped files in the completion message.
Added translations for file selection and conversion history.
Added a message for an unavailable or unauthenticated input folder.
Overwrite prompt text extended with 'Yes to All'.
Added filters, error details and persistent exclusions.
